content:
BQ is a US-based outsourced sales and marketing company. It specializes in B2B appointment setting, lead generation, CRM optimization, and revenue operations support.

The company was founded in 2006, with its headquarters in Austin. EBQ works with a “team-extension” model. Under this, dedicated specialists integrate directly into a client's workflow, CRM systems, and outbound sales Infrastructure

How does EBQ work?

EBQs have a single workflow that includes:

  • Discovery and Strategy- EBQ starts by understanding clients' ICPs, mapping buyer personas, building outreach messaging, and integrating with your CRM.
  • Team Deployment- It assigns dedicated SDRs, project managers, revenue consultants, and data specialists to clients.
  • Outbound Outreach- The company's SDRs execute cold calls, email cadences, LinkedIn Outreach, and lead nurturing.
  • Meeting Booking - EBQ schedules qualified meetings directly into AE calendars, including notes and background data. Later, it reviews data and optimizes campaigns.

Core Capabilities Powering EBQ

Appointment Setting and SDR Services

EBQ's SDRs manage cold outreach, lead qualification, inbound vetting, and meeting scheduling. 

B2B Data Services

It builds targeted contact databases, account lists, and buying committee maps. 

Digital Marketing Support

Its services include content creation, sales copywriting, paid advertising, ABM campaigns, and Email nurture systems.

Sales Closing Support

EBQ can also provide outsourced account executives with demo management, pipeline progression, and contract negotiation support. 

What Makes EBQ Stand Out?

  • Native CRM Integration- EBQ works directly inside the client's system. This gives them complete data ownership and centralized reporting. 
  • Full-Funnel Team Structure: It covers data, marketing, SDR execution, CRM consulting, and sales support in a single structure. 
  • Flat Retainer Alignment- The company uses flat monthly retainers over pay-per-meeting pricing.
  • Dedicated Three-Tier Teams- EBQ's accounts include a revenue consultant, a project manager, and dedicated SDRs.

Key Services

  1. Appointment Setting - EBQ's appointment-setting service includes outbound prospecting, meeting booking, lead qualification, and inbound response handling.
  2. CRM Integration and Consulting- The company manages CRM setup. This involves workflow automation, reporting dashboards, and lead routing. 
  3. B2B Marketing- EBQ manages copywriting, paid campaigns, SEO support, and ABM Execution for B2b clients 
  4. Sales Closing Support - It assigns account executives, demo representatives, and pipeline managers to clients with small or less specialized internal sales teams.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Multi-Threaded Enterprise Outreach- EBQ maps buying committees, executive stakeholders, procurement teams, compliance teams, and more. 
  • Advanced CRM Architecture- It supports Salesforce migrations, Hubspot integration, workflow automation, and bi-directional syncing. 
  • Hybrid Data Validation: The company uses both automated enrichment tools and human verification teams. 
  • GTM Orchestration- EBQ aligns marketing, data, SDR outreach, and CRM workflows. 

Who should work with EBQ?

  • Mid-market B2B firms like enterprise companies with complex sales cycles and CRM-heavy operations.
  • High Value B2B Companies if ACV is USD 10k-USD 50k+ with deals involving multiple stakeholders 
  • Companies lacking internal SDR Infrastructure and internal teams lack outbound structure. 
  • Businesses with messy CRM systems and poor data quality 

Best-Fit Industries

  • B2B SaaS and Software 
  • IT and Managed Services
  • Professional Services 
  • Healthcare and Life Sciences
  • Logistics 
  • Manufacturing and Industries 

Key Use Cases

  • New Territory Expansion - EBQ helps companies enter new markets, test new regions, and validate new buyer segments.
  • Firing AEs to Close - It manages prospecting, qualification, onboarding, and scheduling.
  • CRM Cleanup and Re-Engagement - The company cleans old databases, revives dormant leads, and turns dead CRM records into a pipeline.
  • Inbound Lead Qualification- EBQ acts as an inbound response team, MQL filter layer, and qualification engine. 
  • CRM and Automation - It helps companies fix broken workflows, reporting gaps, and automation failures. 

Pros

  • Strong Data Ownership 
  • Multi-Department Expertise 
  • Quality-focused Incentives 
  • US-Based Communication 

Considerations 

  • Premium Cost Structure (not suitable for startups) 
  • Typical retainers are between USD 5k and USD 10k per month 
  • Onboarding Complexity for new clients

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Belkins- Impressive personalized cold email and LinkedIn outreach 
  • CIENCE Technologies- Ideal for enterprise outbound scale and massive data operations
  • Martal Group- Exceptional for B2B SaaS, IT services, and Tech-focused outbound 
  • SalesRoads- Best human-led cold calling

Conclusion

EbQ is a deeply integrated outsourced revenue operations partner. It works on SDR execution, CRM optimization, data management, marketing support, and pipeline development. The company is ideal for mid-market and enterprise B2B firms, as well as those with high-value sales cycles.

Are you a business that needs scalable outbound Infrastructure with deeply integrated revenue support? EBQ is ideal for streamlining pipeline growth, SDR execution, and revenue operations in one system.
